description: This PHP source file defines the OutboundEmailAccounts class, which extends a base class and manages outbound email account configurations within SuiteCRM. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, access control, and UI components related to email account settings, with customizations for user permissions and security.

classes.name: OutboundEmailAccounts
classes.description: A class for managing outbound email account configurations, including saving, retrieving, access control, and UI rendering, with custom permission checks and security features.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the email account configuration, handling password encryption, authentication type, and admin settings.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves an email account record, decrypting the password and checking access permissions.

methods.name: getUserOutboundAccounts
methods.description: Returns a list of outbound email accounts accessible to the current user, with admin override.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Creates a database query for listing email accounts, with user-specific filtering.

methods.name: hasAccessToPersonalAccount
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to a personal email account.

methods.name: logPersonalAccountAccessDenied
methods.description: Logs an access denied event for personal account access attempts.

methods.name: ACLAccess
methods.description: Determines if the current user has permission to perform a specific action based on ACL rules and personal account access.

methods.name: getFromAddress
methods.description: Returns the email 'from' address, defaulting to the SMTP user if not set.

methods.name: getReplyToAddress
methods.description: Returns the reply-to email address, defaulting to the 'from' address if not set.

methods.name: keepWriteOnlyFieldValues
methods.description: Ensures write-only fields are populated from fetched data.

methods.name: getPasswordChange
methods.description: Returns HTML/JavaScript for password change UI component.

methods.name: getEmailProviderChooser
methods.description: Returns HTML for email provider selection UI.

methods.name: getSendTestEmailBtn
methods.description: Returns HTML/JavaScript for the 'send test email' button and dialog.

methods.name: isAdminOnlyAction
methods.description: Checks if a given action is restricted to admin users.

methods.name: isSecurityGroupBasedAction
methods.description: Checks if a given action is security group based.

methods.name: isNotAllowedAction
methods.description: Checks if a given action is disallowed.
